#### **Job Summary**



The **Assistant Project Manager** supports new ground\-up development and rehabilitation projects from site acquisition through construction and transition to operations. The position assists with project coordination, due diligence, entitlement activities, funding applications, budget tracking, scheduling, and project documentation.



The Assistant Project Manager works closely with the **Vice President of Acquisitions and Development, Project Managers, Construction Managers, Finance Department, Operations Department, and external stakeholders**, including architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, governmental agencies, and real estate professionals. This position requires periodic travel to project sites, meetings, public agencies, conferences, and other business\-related locations.

  


#### **Key Responsibilities**


##### **Site Acquisition \& Due Diligence**


* Coordinate the acquisition of land, existing buildings, and property portfolios for development and acquisition opportunities.
* Assist with assigned acquisition due diligence activities and coordinate the collection of required project information and documentation.
* Assist with the preparation, review, and tracking of due diligence reports, studies, and consultant deliverables.
* Assist with entitlement, permitting, and internal approval processes.
* Maintain project files and due diligence records in accordance with company standards.

##### **Entitlements, Permitting \& Project Oversight**


* Support entitlement and permitting activities and assist with obtaining required approvals from governmental agencies and internal stakeholders.
* Assist and coordinate with documentation regarding developing, analyzing, and maintaining project budgets, schedules, and project tracking reports.
* Assist in monitoring project performance against approved scope, budget, schedule, and quality objectives and report findings to project leadership.
* Assist with documentation for budget review, schedule variances corrective action.
* Assist in monitoring construction progress and communicate potential issues affecting project costs, schedules, quality, or completion to project leadership.
* Supports review of change orders and Requests for Information (RFIs) within established guidelines.
* Assist with billing applications and draw requests for completeness.
* Coordinate easements, permits, utility requirements, and other project\-related activities.
* Coordinate with the tracking of project milestones and assist with preparation of status reports for management.

##### **Project Funding**


* Assist with preparing applications and supporting documentation for Low\-Income Housing Tax Credits (LIHTC), HUD financing programs, grants, and other project funding sources.
* Collaborate with the Finance Department regarding project funding applications, financing requirements, and supporting documentation.
* Assist with due diligence required for financing, equity investment, loan closings, and regulatory approvals.
* Maintain organized records of funding applications, commitments, and compliance\-related documentation.

##### **Travel**


* Travel to project sites, municipal offices, meetings, public hearings, conferences, and other locations as required.
* Attends professional conferences, industry events, and training opportunities as assigned.

##### **Transition to Operations**


* Coordinate with the Operations Department regarding project closeout activities and post\-construction matters.
* Assist with the transition of completed projects from construction to lease\-up and ongoing property operations.
* Coordinates and assist with the collection and transfer of project records, warranties, permits, operating manuals, and related documentation.


**Administrative \& Reporting Responsibilities**


* Assist with preparation of correspondence, reports, presentations, meeting materials, and project\-related documentation.
* Coordinate project tracking tools, schedules, development files, and reporting systems.
* Attend project meetings and prepare follow\-up notes and action item summaries as requested.

jobs.description:
The U.S. mortgage market is a $14 trillion pillar of the economy — and much of it still runs on fax machines, overnight shipping, and manual workflows. Snapdocs is changing that. Our platform currently powers 20% of all real estate closings in the country, and we’re just getting started.


We design workflow software and AI\-driven automation that connects lenders, settlement teams, notaries, and investors — eliminating friction, reducing risk, and delivering a faster, simpler closing for every borrower. Our customers range from the largest mortgage lenders to independent title companies. They trust us because we solve real operational pain with empathy, rigor, and reliability.


We’re backed by Sequoia, Y Combinator, and F\-Prime, and we’re building for the long term.

**Why this role exists**
------------------------


Snapdocs is the trusted infrastructure for high\-stakes transactions. We started in mortgage, where trust is not assumed, the work is fragmented across many parties, and the cost of mistakes is real \- and are bringing that same standard of trust to other markets.


Years of automating the hardest tasks gave us something more foundational than workflow software: an AI\-native platform that makes complex work easy to complete, hard to get wrong, and built to withstand scrutiny over time.


Field marketing turns that promise into tangible presence and relationships in the market by owning the programs that put Snapdocs in front of the right audiences, in the right settings, for the right reasons. You’ll turn conferences, executive programs, customer gatherings, partner activations, and account\-based programs into credible brand experiences, tight relationships, and measurable commercial impact.

**The role**
------------


This is a hands\-on field marketing role with broad ownership. You’ll help shape where and why Snapdocs shows up, choose the programs most relevant to our audiences and business priorities, manage the details that make those programs work, and connect every program to coordinated Sales and Marketing follow\-up.


Events are the primary channel, but field marketing is broader than event execution. It also includes regional programs, executive presence, customer and prospect engagement, partner programs, and account\-based plays across Snapdocs’ markets. You’ll help make our mission tangible by creating experiences that simplify complexity, build trust, and move the right relationships forward.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Robotics Customer Success Intern
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
====================


Each year, 2\.5 trillion hours are spent on household chores. At Matic, we’re on a mission to recapture that lost time, and we’re doing it by revolutionizing home robotics.


Our first product, also called Matic, is a Wall\-E\-esque floor cleaning robot. We've built what amounts to "full self\-driving in the home” with real\-time 3D mapping, adaptive path\-tracking, and a precise semantic understanding of the home. Our breakthroughs in spatial AI allow Matic to work reliably in real homes, using only RGB cameras and neural networks running on\-device.

**Privacy First**
-----------------


What happens in the home, stays in the home. Our robots are private by design, with all data processing performed by the robot itself, not in the cloud.

**Our Approach**
----------------


Before the iPhone, consumers adopted several distinct devices; cell phones, PDAs, and portable music players each served a particular need. We believe in a similar progression for home robotics, starting with single\-purpose robots and building iteratively toward more complex capabilities over time.

**Our Culture**
---------------


Matic is a tight\-knit and collaborative team, singularly focused on building products our customers will cherish. We're ultra\-hardworking people committed to solving tough problems that save precious time and energy.

**About the role**
==================


Matic is building the next generation of consumer home robotics. Small team, high ownership, moving fast. We're looking for a Robotics Customer Success Intern to own ticket resolution end\-to\-end.  

  

This is a hands\-on role. You'll be in the weeds with customers every day: running onboarding, answering tickets, and closely collaborating with Engineering, Product, and Marketing teams. You'll help build the systems, playbooks, and infrastructure that let us deliver a deeply personal experience to every single customer as we grow from ten thousand to a hundred thousand and beyond.  

  

We believe that the best customer service is no customer service, a product so intuitive and reliable that customers never need to reach out. The second\-best is just\-in\-time, self\-service help that anticipates questions before they're asked. You'll build both: proactive systems that eliminate friction, and a white\-glove experience for the moments that matter most.  

  

**What you’ll do:**  

  

**Deliver a Three\-Michelin\-Star Customer Experience**

* Own tickets end\-to\-end. First response to resolution. No missed replies, no open threads, no customer left hanging.
* Diagnose bugs, walk customers through fixes, and coordinate repairs or replacements when needed.
* Escalate the hard ones to Engineering, Product, or Ops, and drive them to closure.
* Analyze customer issue data obsessively. Spot patterns across tickets. Surface recurring issues, root causes, and product gaps to the team so the same problem doesn't hit a second customer.
* Develop deep product knowledge across hardware, software, algorithms, and the Matic app. Know the product inside and out: every component, every edge case, every workaround.
* Develop and deploy AI tools such as skills and agents to improve response times and support quality, and build a feedback loop that results in continuous improvement of customer success processes

**What we look for:**

* Deep customer empathy paired with a bias toward action. You care about the customer, and you move fast to resolve the issue.
* Technical curiosity. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to understand how a complex hardware \+ software \+ AI product works well enough to troubleshoot, explain, and advocate intelligently.
* Bachelor's degree completed or in progress. Technical or analytical background preferred.
* This role can be a path to full\-time for the right candidate, based on performance and team needs.

**What we value:**

* Customer obsession. Every interaction, every email, every call, every unboxing, should feel like the customer is the most important person in the world. Because to us, they are.

jobs.description:
The Executive Assistant supports the pastoral staff and daily operations of Church of the Advent Hope by executing defined recurring tasks and completing ad\-hoc assignments delegated by the Lead Pastor and the Pastor for Community Life. This role is an executor — not a strategist, operations director, or department head. The person in this role keeps the engine of the church running by handling inbound communications, coordinating the calendar with the Communications \& Marketing Director, and providing reliable, detail\-oriented support to the staff team.

Core Responsibility Areas

The Executive Assistant has three core responsibility areas. Everything this role does should be traceable back to one of these three buckets.

1\. Communications Triage (inbound)

* Monitor the general church inbox (info@adventhope.org and equivalent aliases) during scheduled work hours. Respond to routine inquiries using approved templates; route pastoral, financial, or sensitive inquiries to the appropriate pastor or staff member within one business day.
* Monitor the church voicemail line daily during scheduled work hours. Return routine calls within one business day; forward pastoral\-care calls to the appropriate pastor by end of day.
* Monitor Intercom (website chat) during scheduled work hours. Respond to routine questions; route complex questions to the right staff member.
* Receive and sort physical mail. Log checks and deposit\-ready items for the Bookkeeper; scan and forward time\-sensitive mail to the appropriate staff member.
* Maintain a running log of communications volume (counts by channel, types of inquiries) and report monthly to the Lead Pastor.

2\. Calendar and Schedule Coordination (with Communications \& Marketing Director)

* Maintain the master church calendar (Google Workspace) as the single source of truth for services, events, staff meetings, rentals, and pastoral availability.
* Work weekly with the Communications \& Marketing Director to confirm which events are being marketed, on what schedule, and through which channels (website, email, social). The Executive Assistant owns accuracy of the calendar; the Communications \& Marketing Director owns promotion of it.
* Open and confirm rental bookings on the calendar; coordinate with the Property Manager on room setup needs.
* Schedule and send calendar invites for pastoral staff meetings, board meetings, elders' meetings, and other recurring gatherings.
* Compile information packets for quarterly board meetings — agenda materials, prior minutes, supporting documents — and circulate in advance of the meeting.
* Handle RSVPs, sign\-ups, and registrations for events not handled by Eventbrite self\-service — e.g., baptism and baby dedication preparation, pastoral appointments, Conversations \& Cuisine seating.

3\. Staff Support and Task Execution

* Execute specific tasks assigned by the Lead Pastor or Pastor for Community Life through the shared task system (Todoist). Acknowledge receipt within 1 business day; confirm completion with a brief status update.
* Prepare Sabbath morning support materials: update the lobby announcement board, ensure interest cards and tithe cards are stocked, and stage any printed handouts provided by the Communications \& Marketing Director.
* Attend the weekly staff meeting and the weekly admin meeting (currently Tuesdays and Wednesdays via Zoom). Take notes and circulate action items within 1 business day.
* Compile materials for quarterly board meetings (does not attend the meeting itself); circulate minutes drafted by the Clerk.
* Maintain a simple, well\-organized filing system (Google Drive) for staff documents, vendor records, and church records.
* Order office supplies and Sabbath\-morning consumables (printer supplies, kitchen paper goods) against a pre\-approved budget set by the Lead Pastor.
* Maintain routine vendor relationships for administrative, office\-supply, and software\-subscription vendors — confirm invoices, process renewals, escalate issues. Building vendors, contractors, insurance, and renter relationships remain with the Property Manager.
* Provide administrative support for baptism, baby dedication, wedding, and funeral logistics as directed by a pastor.

Weekly Schedule

The Executive Assistant works a set weekly schedule, Tuesday through Friday, 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM (20 hours per week):

* Tuesday: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM. Staff meeting attendance; triage weekend email/voicemail backlog; circulate staff meeting action items.
* Wednesday: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM. Admin meeting attendance; calendar review with the Communications \& Marketing Director; weekly task triage.
* Thursday: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM. Process mail; review routine vendor invoices and renewals; respond to ad\-hoc task list; weekly staff coordination.
* Friday: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM. Sabbath preparation handoff to the Sabbath Coordinator and Support Team Lead; confirm next\-week calendar.

Schedule flexes during Advent, Holy Week, and the start of the church year. Additional hours during these peaks may be approved in advance by the Lead Pastor.

Skills and Qualifications

Required

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in email and phone contexts.
* Demonstrated proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets).
* Comfort learning and using digital tools (current stack includes Salesforce, Zoom, Squarespace, Todoist, Constant Contact, Mowgli, Intercom, Ramp, Proclaim; the Executive Assistant is not expected to administer all of these but will interact with several).
* Ability to use Anthropic Claude as a working tool — Claude will be part of the daily rhythm of this job for drafting, summarizing, triaging, and task execution. Willingness to learn responsible AI use within the church's guidelines is essential.
* Proficient at problem\-solving and getting things done — bias toward action, ability to close out tasks without repeated handholding

We're looking for someone who is curious, organized, accountable, and excited to learn. Prior experience in procurement, accounts payable, or vendor management is not required.

* Identify and resolve operational issues that could delay order completion
* Monitor workflows and follow up on orders requiring additional attention

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

**PT of the City** is a physical therapy practice dedicated to providing the highest level of care. Founded in 2020 in New York, US, we are a physical therapist\-owned and operated clinic offering comprehensive evaluations, hands\-on/manual therapy, innovative treatment techniques, personalized exercise programs, and patient education. Our approach is centered around a concierge model, ensuring that every aspect of the patient experience is personalized to meet individual needs, preferences, and goals.

With multiple branches across New York City, **PT of the City** is committed to delivering exceptional care and fostering a supportive environment for both our patients and staff.

**Job Objective**  
We are looking for a creative, full\-time Video Content Creator to plan, shoot, and edit social media videos. With **33 locations**, your main goal is to build our brand and showcase our clinics by creating engaging, on\-site video content using both professional cameras and smartphones.  
**What You Will Do**

* **Plan \& Schedule:** Create and manage a clear content calendar. You will plan out what videos need to be shot, when to film them, and when to post them.
* **Shoot Video:** Act as our on\-the\-ground videographer. Film high\-quality footage on\-site at our various clinics using both professional camera gear and your smartphone.
* **Edit \& Create:** Edit the footage into short, engaging videos (Reels, TikToks) using apps like CapCut and Adobe Premiere. Add trending audio, text, and effects.
* **Capture Patient Stories:** Reach out to patients and doctors to film real video testimonials and success stories.
* **Manage Social Media:** Post the content to Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook on time, and reply to comments from our community.
* **Track \& Learn:** Check basic social media numbers (views, likes, shares) to see what types of videos perform best, and use that information to plan better shoots.
* **Team Collaboration:** Work closely with the broader marketing and design teams to make sure your videos match the company's overall brand.

**What You Need**

* **Experience:** **At least 1 year of experience** heavily focused on planning, shooting, and editing social media video content.
* **Equipment Knowledge:** You must know how to comfortably shoot video with both professional cameras and modern smartphones.
* **Editing Skills:** Strong hands\-on experience with video editing software (like CapCut or Adobe Premiere) and basic design tools (like Canva).
* **Education:** A degree in Video Production, Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred.
* **Language:** Fluent in English.

**Who You Are**

* **Highly Organized:** You are great at planning ahead and keeping a busy content calendar on track across multiple clinic locations.
* **Creative:** You know how to tell a good story through video and have a great eye for lighting and camera angles.
* **People Person:** You know how to make patients and staff feel comfortable when you point a camera at them.
* **Self\-Starter:** You can manage your own time, coordinate with different clinics, and get the shoots done independently.

* Competitive salary.
* Medical insurance.
* PTOs.

* A dynamic and collaborative team.

jobs.description:
**About the Opportunity**

Innoface Systems, Inc. is seeking a motivated and highly organized Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand our commercial client base and create new sales opportunities.

We provide professional audiovisual technology solutions for businesses, government organizations, educational institutions and other commercial clients. Our solutions include conference and collaboration systems, professional audio, digital signage, video walls and integrated audiovisual environments.

This is a remote position based in the Atlanta metropolitan area. The selected candidate will primarily work from home but should be available for occasional local client meetings, networking opportunities, training and other business\-related activities as needed.

The BDR will play an important role at the front end of our sales process by identifying prospective customers, starting conversations, qualifying opportunities and helping move the right prospects into our sales pipeline.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys business development, relationship building and consultative conversations and wants the opportunity to grow into progressively greater sales responsibility.

For a high performer who demonstrates strong sales results and leadership potential, this role may provide a future pathway toward sales leadership and management of an outside sales team.

**What You'll Do**

Your primary responsibility will be generating and qualifying new business opportunities for Innoface Systems.

You will:

* Prospect for new commercial customers through outbound calling, email, networking, referrals and targeted account research
* Consistently meet established outbound calling and prospecting activity goals
* Respond promptly and professionally to inbound sales inquiries
* Conduct initial qualification and discovery conversations with prospective customers
* Meet established goals for qualification and discovery conversations
* Ask effective questions to understand the customer's organization, needs, challenges, timing and potential project requirements
* Schedule qualified sales meetings and coordinate a smooth handoff to the appropriate sales or technical team member
* Maintain consistent follow\-up with prospects who are not yet ready to move forward
* Research companies and decision\-makers within target markets
* Develop and maintain an organized pipeline of prospective customers
* Maintain complete and accurate CRM records for calls, emails, meetings, follow\-ups and sales opportunities
* Prepare and prioritize prospecting activity to ensure consistent outreach and follow\-up
* Participate in sales meetings, coaching sessions and professional development
* Collaborate with sales, engineering and operations as opportunities progress through the sales process
* Participate in occasional Atlanta\-area client meetings, networking events or business\-development activities as needed

As you develop in the position, you may take on increased responsibility for discovery, account development, proposal presentation and additional portions of the sales cycle.

**What Success Looks Like**

This is a performance\-based position with clear expectations and measurable goals.

Key performance indicators may include:

* Achievement of established outbound calling and prospecting goals
* Consistent outbound email and business\-development activity
* Achievement of qualification and discovery conversation goals
* Qualified sales meetings scheduled
* New sales\-qualified opportunities created
* Qualified pipeline value generated
* Consistent follow\-up with active prospects
* Prompt response to inbound leads
* Accurate and timely CRM documentation
* Progression of BDR\-generated opportunities through the sales pipeline

While closed revenue is an important company objective, the BDR's primary responsibility is to consistently create qualified opportunities that have a legitimate potential to become customers.

Activity matters, but quality matters too. We are not looking for someone simply checking boxes or making calls for the sake of making calls. Successful BDRs create productive conversations that lead to real business opportunities.

**What We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who is professional, persistent, curious and exceptionally dependable with follow\-through.

You should be comfortable initiating conversations with people you haven't met while also recognizing that successful business development is about much more than making cold calls.

Strong candidates will know how to listen, ask thoughtful questions, identify genuine business needs and build relationships over time.

Account Manager  


We help make your world a safer place.  


Securitas is a global company that offers the most advanced and sustainable security solutions in the industry. We are located in 47 countries and have 355,000 employees worldwide and over 150,000 clients.  


Securitas plays an essential role for our clients and in society. The Account Manager position helps maintain a safe and secure environment for our clients by managing the security services and related operations provided to an assigned group of smaller accounts including client service and problem resolution, service enhancement and expansion, new business development, operational effectiveness, preparation of post orders, staffing, scheduling, supervision and training.  


We are driven by a clear corporate culture and purpose, which helps us live according to our values of Integrity, Vigilance, and Helpfulness. These values are at the heart of our culture, help define who we are and guide our actions.  


As an Account Manager you will be performing a variety of management functions for assigned accounts; while providing lead direction to Security Supervisors on requirements, priorities of work and coordinating any necessary needs of the site. If you have experience in positions like Operations Manager, Site Supervisor or Account Manager this role is a great fit for you.  


Are you interested in being part of our Team?  


* Apply quickly and efficiently online
* Interview from the convenience of your own home
* Weekly pay
* Competitive benefits
* Flexible schedules

With over 80 years of protecting the things that matter, we’ve seen more than most. That’s why Securitas is the partner of choice for companies and an employer of choice for candidates worldwide.  


See a different world.  


“Securitas is committed to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic.”  


\#AF\-PSIL  


Our Company Mission:  
Securitas’ mission is to protect homes, workplaces, and communities by providing the security services they need to protect their assets, safeguard their people, and maintain their ability to generate profits.  


Our Values:  
Securitas’ core values \- Integrity, Vigilance and Helpfulness \- are the foundation for our employees to build trust with customers, colleagues, and the surrounding community.  


Integrity:  
Securitas employees are honest and trusted by customers to safeguard their premises and valuables. We don’t compromise on integrity and create an open forum for our employees and customers to voice opinions, report improprieties, and share information.  


Vigilance:  
Seeing, hearing, and evaluating. A Securitas employee is always attentive and often notices things that others don’t. Their vigilance is necessary in order to be aware of potential risks or incidents that may take place on our customers’ premises.  


Helpfulness:  
As part of an on\-going effort to ensure safety, Securitas employees are always ready to help if an incident occurs that requires intervention regardless of whether or not it is directly related to their job.  
Securitas employees come from all walks of life, bringing with them a variety of distinctive skills and perspectives. United through our common purpose, we provide the security needed to safeguard our clients' assets and people. Our core values \- Integrity, Vigilance and Helpfulness \- are represented by the three red dots in the Securitas logo. If you live by these values, we’re looking for you to join the Securitas team.  


Benefits include:  
Retirement plan  
Employer\-provided medical and dental coverage  
Company\-paid life insurance  
Voluntary life and disability insurance  
Employee assistance plan  
Securitas Saves discount program  
Paid holidays  
Paid time away from work  


Additionally, some populations may have the availability of accessing earned wages on a daily basis, prior to payday. Restrictions and fees may apply.  
Certain waiting periods may also apply. Paid time away from work may be available either through a combination of vacation and sick time or under a PTO policy, depending on local requirements. Benefits may be different for union members.

new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

new_jobs.title: Executive Assistant
new_jobs.description:
The Executive Assistant supports the pastoral staff and daily operations of Church of the Advent Hope by executing defined recurring tasks and completing ad\-hoc assignments delegated by the Lead Pastor and the Pastor for Community Life. This role is an executor — not a strategist, operations director, or department head. The person in this role keeps the engine of the church running by handling inbound communications, coordinating the calendar with the Communications \& Marketing Director, and providing reliable, detail\-oriented support to the staff team.

Core Responsibility Areas

The Executive Assistant has three core responsibility areas. Everything this role does should be traceable back to one of these three buckets.

1\. Communications Triage (inbound)

* Monitor the general church inbox (info@adventhope.org and equivalent aliases) during scheduled work hours. Respond to routine inquiries using approved templates; route pastoral, financial, or sensitive inquiries to the appropriate pastor or staff member within one business day.
* Monitor the church voicemail line daily during scheduled work hours. Return routine calls within one business day; forward pastoral\-care calls to the appropriate pastor by end of day.
* Monitor Intercom (website chat) during scheduled work hours. Respond to routine questions; route complex questions to the right staff member.
* Receive and sort physical mail. Log checks and deposit\-ready items for the Bookkeeper; scan and forward time\-sensitive mail to the appropriate staff member.
* Maintain a running log of communications volume (counts by channel, types of inquiries) and report monthly to the Lead Pastor.

2\. Calendar and Schedule Coordination (with Communications \& Marketing Director)

* Maintain the master church calendar (Google Workspace) as the single source of truth for services, events, staff meetings, rentals, and pastoral availability.
* Work weekly with the Communications \& Marketing Director to confirm which events are being marketed, on what schedule, and through which channels (website, email, social). The Executive Assistant owns accuracy of the calendar; the Communications \& Marketing Director owns promotion of it.
* Open and confirm rental bookings on the calendar; coordinate with the Property Manager on room setup needs.
* Schedule and send calendar invites for pastoral staff meetings, board meetings, elders' meetings, and other recurring gatherings.
* Compile information packets for quarterly board meetings — agenda materials, prior minutes, supporting documents — and circulate in advance of the meeting.
* Handle RSVPs, sign\-ups, and registrations for events not handled by Eventbrite self\-service — e.g., baptism and baby dedication preparation, pastoral appointments, Conversations \& Cuisine seating.

3\. Staff Support and Task Execution

* Execute specific tasks assigned by the Lead Pastor or Pastor for Community Life through the shared task system (Todoist). Acknowledge receipt within 1 business day; confirm completion with a brief status update.
* Prepare Sabbath morning support materials: update the lobby announcement board, ensure interest cards and tithe cards are stocked, and stage any printed handouts provided by the Communications \& Marketing Director.
* Attend the weekly staff meeting and the weekly admin meeting (currently Tuesdays and Wednesdays via Zoom). Take notes and circulate action items within 1 business day.
* Compile materials for quarterly board meetings (does not attend the meeting itself); circulate minutes drafted by the Clerk.
* Maintain a simple, well\-organized filing system (Google Drive) for staff documents, vendor records, and church records.
* Order office supplies and Sabbath\-morning consumables (printer supplies, kitchen paper goods) against a pre\-approved budget set by the Lead Pastor.
* Maintain routine vendor relationships for administrative, office\-supply, and software\-subscription vendors — confirm invoices, process renewals, escalate issues. Building vendors, contractors, insurance, and renter relationships remain with the Property Manager.
* Provide administrative support for baptism, baby dedication, wedding, and funeral logistics as directed by a pastor.

Weekly Schedule

The Executive Assistant works a set weekly schedule, Tuesday through Friday, 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM (20 hours per week):

* Tuesday: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM. Staff meeting attendance; triage weekend email/voicemail backlog; circulate staff meeting action items.
* Wednesday: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM. Admin meeting attendance; calendar review with the Communications \& Marketing Director; weekly task triage.
* Thursday: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM. Process mail; review routine vendor invoices and renewals; respond to ad\-hoc task list; weekly staff coordination.
* Friday: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM. Sabbath preparation handoff to the Sabbath Coordinator and Support Team Lead; confirm next\-week calendar.

Schedule flexes during Advent, Holy Week, and the start of the church year. Additional hours during these peaks may be approved in advance by the Lead Pastor.

Skills and Qualifications

Required

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in email and phone contexts.
* Demonstrated proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets).
* Comfort learning and using digital tools (current stack includes Salesforce, Zoom, Squarespace, Todoist, Constant Contact, Mowgli, Intercom, Ramp, Proclaim; the Executive Assistant is not expected to administer all of these but will interact with several).
* Ability to use Anthropic Claude as a working tool — Claude will be part of the daily rhythm of this job for drafting, summarizing, triaging, and task execution. Willingness to learn responsible AI use within the church's guidelines is essential.
* Proficient at problem\-solving and getting things done — bias toward action, ability to close out tasks without repeated handholding
